products.title: Newton Running Distance S 9
products.description: Newton Distance S 9 Running Shoes A staple racer to many, including 3X Ironman World Champion Craig Alexander. This stability model of the award-winning Distance features light minimalistic overlays and dual-density foam for a high-performance feel. Ultra Breathable Mesh Upper The Newton Distance 9 running shoe is built for speed. Engineered with an ultra lightweight, ultra-breathable mesh upper the Distance 9 will have you clocking up the miles and hitting new records without feeling the heat. As cool air permeates the mesh, any uncomfortable heat build-up is removed creating a regulated temperature and a healthy environment that feet can thrive in. The new minimalistic overlays offer support without adding unnecessary bulk or weight and work in tandem with a traditional lace closure for a secure, locked down fit. The no-sew toe cap eliminates discomfort from chaffing and rubbing for a distraction-free ride. Newtonium Cushioned Midsole Featuring a full foot Newtonium cushioned midsole, cushioned lugs in the forefoot and heel provide full-foot cushioned protection, attenuating shock impact where you strike down the most alleviating stress on the joints and reducing fatigue. Working in tandem with the Newtonium cushioned midsole is the action/reaction technology providing exceptional energy return. Generated by the active movement of the cushioned lugs, the active/reactive technology creates a trampoline-like effect responding to your every step with quicker bounce-back for effective and highly responsive energy return. Constructed with a second density medial support the Distance S 9 provides a firmer medial side post to prevent overpronation during running. SHARC Outsole The Distance 9 shoes SHARC Outsole consists of a high abrasion and high-density rubber providing increased and enhanced floor fighting traction in both dry and wet conditions.

dialogue.agent:
Here's the breakdown on the **ROCKROOSTER Bedrock - Mens Urban Waterproof Anti-Fatigue Outdoor Hiking Boots**:

- **Rating**: 4.9/5 from 11 reviews
- **Key features**: Waterproof (ROOF-TEX membrane), Vibram sole for excellent grip, lightweight, anti-fatigue design, and a four-season hiking boot

Customers absolutely rave about the comfort. One reviewer (a 68-year-old hiker) said the insoles provide "good step recoil" and make them "extremely comfortable," even comparing them favorably to Army boots. Another reviewer with foot challenges said these boots "all but disappear" comfort-wise and called them *more comfortable than any sneakers* — they've become their go-to shoes. They're described as having an "athletic shoe top and midsole with a gravel gripper Vibram trail sole" — so they've got that casual feel while being rugged and durable. Just keep in mind the fit runs snug, so if you have wider feet, you may want to go up half a size.

Would you like to look into any other options as well, or does this one seem like it could be the right fit for you?

top_reviews.title: Crowin' over my ROCKROOSTER Bedrock boots
top_reviews.text: I took these ROCKROOSTER Bedrock boots for a hike off-trail. I drug 'em through hollers' and hills, briars and sharp rocks in a boulder -filled Kentucky creek. I tried out their waterproof function by standing in the creek with water covering the top of the toe section. No leaks,(except when I stepped in a 12 inch deep water hole with these 6 inch boots! Duhh!). The vibram sole was very "grippy" and kept my feet stable , and my ankles were well supported. The insole in ROCKROOSTER boots,(I have two pair), gives you what I call good step recoil and help make the boots extremely comfortable, and my feet did not overheat. When this 68 year old man returned from this vigorous hike my feet and lower legs were not as fatigued as when I wear my Army boots. I like 'em! Be aware that these are URBAN trail boots when I say that the briars and sharp rocks left the softer midsole kinda' chewed up. These boots are not designed for my hillbilly abuse, but they did not fail in any respect. I wear a 10 , and a 10 1/2 was comfortable. I would describe this particular style as a boot with an athletic shoe top and midsole , with a gravel gripper Vibram trail sole. By the way, the strings are plenty long. Thanks folks.  Rick T., Ky.

top_reviews.title: Your Feet Will Thank You!
top_reviews.text: This is my second pair that I ordered. I usually wear a 10 extra wide in my work boots from Rock Rooster so I ordered the same size for these hiking boots. The toe box is a little more narrow on the hiking boots so I sent them back and reordered a size 10.5 extra wide.  Perfect fit!  These hiking boots are so comfortable. I have some foot challenges and when I wear these hiking boots they all but disappear.  These boots are more comfortable then any of my sneakers and have become my go to shoes. I leave them a bit loose when I take them off and when I put them on my feet slide right into them. Lacing up is easy. A quick pull on the laces tighten them all the way to the bottom then a crisscross on the speed laces and tie them. Often times with boots there’s a lot of tugging and pulling on the laces to get them tightened up.  I’ve been a Rock Rooster customer and fan for about 3 years now. Their quality is always high and their comfort level is unsurpassed. I live in Arizona and now that we’re having cooler temperatures I’m looking forward to some desert hikes. I’m confident these boots will fill the bill perfectly. Lastly, I need to mention that they are very lightweight!  Buy and enjoy!!!
